Holding the 4 least volatile of 20 names, equal-weight, rebalanced every 10 days, harvests this premium with modest turnover.

- I ran two backtests. Low-volatility on the T universe showed Sharpe 2.1 with positive IC over 2023–2024. Mean reversion on the W universe was strongly negative (Sharpe −11), so I dropped it.
- I pitched low-volatility (top 4 of 20, 60-day vol, monthly rebalance). It **failed the held-out test**: IC −0.03 against a 0.03 threshold, deflated Sharpe 0.01 against 0.95, and capacity about $40k against a $1M minimum. It passed only the correlation gate.

The in-sample result did not survive the holdout, so I'm not treating it as a real edge. I haven't run more research, because every backtest counts against the pod's deflated Sharpe and I'd be searching blind. The next step is a new hypothesis with a clear mechanism, not a parameter tweak on the same idea.
